Their armies are made up of slow warriors with powerful weaponry, which rely on having a solid long-term plan to make up for their low mobility. The Dwarf Guilds rapidly expanded outwards from their home world, hoping to claim ever more of the galaxy’s resources. These ambitions eventually resulted in them starting a war that they could not win. Desperation led them to activate a machine that would end up destroying much of the Sirius Sector. Now the scattered survivors seek to rebuild with the same ambition of their predecessors. The Dwarves originated on a mineral rich but inhospitable world. In order to escape the harsh conditions of the surface, their civilization developed underground where conditions were more stable. As ... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/dwarf-guilds) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Sturdy: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away, they get +1 to defense rolls. ### Special Rules Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). Infiltrate: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3” away from enemy unit. Melee Slayer: When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher. Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Precision Frenzy: Place one marker on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two markers. For each marker all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls until the end of the game. Re-Position Artillery: Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9". Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Speed Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply). Surge: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Swift: This model may ignore the Slow rule. ### Aura Special Rules Ignores Cover when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Ignores Cover when shooting. Increased Shooting Range Aura: This model and its unit get +6" range when shooting. Infiltrate Aura: This model and its unit get Infiltrate. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Stealth Aura: This model and its unit get Stealth. Sturdy Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Sturdy Boost. Swift Aura: This model and its unit get Swift. Unpredictable Fighter Aura: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Fighter. Read more ### Spells Battle Rune (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +6" range when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Breaking Rune (1): Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 1 hit with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. Armor Rune (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Sturdy Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Smiting Rune (2): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 4 hits with AP(1) and Shred. Deceleration Rune (3): Pick up to three enemy units within 18", which moves -2" when using Advance actions and -4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply). Cleaving Rune (3): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 3 hits with Blast(3). ### Units ### Heroes Powersuit Champion [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 125pts Shock Hammer(A2, Blast(3)) Fortified, Hero,
